title: BetaDreamModelConfig
description:
The model that runs a dream, from the request that created it.

The dream uses this model for all of its work. The response always gives the model as an object, even if the request gave only a model ID.

id.description: The ID of the model that runs the dream, as given in the request that created it.

speed.description: How fast the model generates output for the dream. Always `standard`.
